description: This file defines the internal class 'GrainVersionManifest' which manages querying and retrieving grain interface and grain type versions, supported silos, and related metadata within the Orleans distributed runtime. It interacts with the cluster manifest to cache and update supported versions and silo support data.

classes.name: GrainVersionManifest.Cache
classes.description: A private class used to cache supported versions and silo support information for quick access and synchronization.

methods.name: GetLocalVersion
methods.description: Returns the local version for a specified grain interface type, considering generic mappings.

methods.name: GetAvailableVersions
methods.description: Retrieves all known versions of a grain interface type, consulting cache and mappings.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns the set of silos supporting a specific grain interface type and version.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns the set of silos supporting a specific grain type.

methods.name: GetSupportedSilos
methods.description: Returns the set of silos supporting a given grain type, interface, and version list.
